title: Synthetic Data Module on Python 3.9
summary: A command-line and notebook-based module for training synthetic data generators on tabular CSV datasets, generating synthetic rows at scale (including chunked generation of 100M+ rows), and evaluating statistical similarity between real and synthetic data. It directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer for model training/sampling and uses sdmetrics' QualityReport and column metrics for evaluation.
evidence: syndata_model_train_py39.ipynb: model = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata); model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=...)
